variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays his bow and quiver to have the wolves cleared from his flock.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Who's that? Is somebody out there? Good. I don't dare leave the fold. The wolves from the Ashwood have been at my sheep every night!

Clear them off and my old bow and quiver are yours. Their den is east of here. You'll smell it. And mind yourself. They're bold and they're hungry.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Get up into the Ashwood, lad! Every night I lose another one. Hurry! Find their den and finish them off before dark.

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Wonderful! Every sheep I have left owes you its life.

Take the bow and quiver, as promised! But I can't stand about now! The flock's scattered all over the hills! I must round them up before dark if I'm to keep any of them at all!

journal.text: Go into the Ashwood and kill the wolves raiding Ulric's flock.

variants.specifics: Druvak: Grizzick, an old ore carter, wants the Bears driven out of the North Drift, where Pudd keeps leaving his supper.

offer.speaker: Grizzick
offer.text:
Huff... huff... The Bears... they're back in the North Drift!

Huff... That lump Pudd left his supper down there again... and the ore carts are due through today!

Will you get rid of them for a poor old carter?

completion.speaker: Grizzick
completion.text: Thank you! Here's a bow and a bit of gold for your trouble. I'd help more, but these old legs would only get in your way. Skarn's Trolls have a nasty habit of picking off the slow ones.

journal.text: Drive the Bears out of the North Drift for Grizzick the carter.

variants.specifics: Okkum: Fennick the punt-man wants the Troll on the old sluice gate driven off, but the player must sign Ebbin's bounty book first.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Ahoy there! My punt goes no farther than the last stilts, not while a Troll is squatting on the old sluice gate!

Will you go and drive the brute off? Put your mark in Ebbin's bounty book first, and I know there's a fat purse waiting for you, because no eel boat in Okkum can get past him!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
The Troll is gone? Gone for good? Then the eel boats go out tonight!

Your mark is in the book, so the bounty's yours. Here, 100 in gold!

Ebbin says the Witch's lights were burning over the Black Reeds again last night. Keep this potion handy... you may want it before long.

journal.text: Sign the bounty book and drive off the sluice Troll.

variants.specifics: Thrane: Warden Krell wants Skell the Poisoner, bought out of the castle dungeon by a crooked turnkey and now guiding the Trolls, put down in the Thornwood.

offer.speaker: Warden Krell
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! I'm glad you've come at last, for the dungeon of Thrane has been disgraced! My own turnkey sold Skell the Poisoner his freedom for a sack of gold, and now the villain is guiding Gruthak's Trolls against our patrols! Please seek him out in the Thornwood south of the walls and put an end to him as swiftly as you can!

reminder.speaker: Warden Krell
reminder.text: Hurry to the Thornwood! Don't let him slip away! For if Skell lives, Gruthak will have the cruelest poisoner in the land at his side, I fear!

completion.speaker: Warden Krell
completion.text:
Well done! So Skell is slain! I'd hoped to see him back in irons, truth be told... but no one in Thrane will mourn him! At last our patrols can ride out again!

Here, take this purse and these potions. They'll be needed... and soon, I'd wager.

journal.text: Put an end to Skell the Poisoner!

variants.specifics: Skellow: Gorrick the net-mender wants Hulvo's raiders thrown out of his boathouse.

offer.speaker: Gorrick
offer.text:
Good day. Gorrick's the name. And Mayor Oskelt sent you over, eh? Well, Hulvo's raiders have moved into my boathouse up the shore, boat and all, and they've nailed the doors shut behind them!

Will you throw them out for me?

reminder.speaker: Gorrick
reminder.text: Not many folks would stand up to raiders for an old net-mender.

completion.speaker: Gorrick
completion.text: They're gone?! Wonderful! Take this purse -- 80 gold pieces. And these boots too. You'll want them out on the mudflats.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Mabeth, the College cook, pays to have the Imps' nest in the old cistern burned out.

offer.speaker: Mabeth
offer.text:
Pardon the mess, lad, but the Imps were through my kitchen again last night. They come up out of the old cistern under the College, and every time there's more of them.

That nest has to be burned out, but the little devils have blocked the cistern stair behind them. Gorwin the porter knows another way down. Take this shield. Imps throw whatever they can lift.

reminder.speaker: Mabeth
reminder.text: That shield will come in handy once the Imps start throwing pots. Gorwin can show you the way down. Good luck and be careful!

completion.speaker: Mabeth
completion.text: I'm sure the Masters will be glad to have their suppers back on the table. Here's 100 gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Imps are raiding the College kitchen -- find their nest and burn it out!

variants.specifics: Fort Krell: Ostrik, who keeps the fort's beacon, pays to have the Imps cleared out of the Beacon Tower.

offer.speaker: Ostrik
offer.text:
There you are. Good. What I need of you now cannot wait.

Imps have overrun the old Beacon Tower on the north wall. Nobody has lit the fire up there in days. If it isn't burning, they'll walk right past us. They're due any day!

My watchmen have gone up twice and come down twice. Not one of them will try it again. You may do better.

Tobbe the lamp-man is still up at the top. Look for him. Here's a bow, too. Imps don't care much for an arrow in the hide.

Clear those Imps out of my tower, quickly, and I will see you are well paid.

reminder.speaker: Ostrik
reminder.text: Still at it? Then back up those stairs with you! The fire must be lit before dark!

completion.speaker: Ostrik
completion.text: I hope those Imps never show their ugly faces on our wall again! I'm still not convinced Ghrulg sent them, though. Here's 100 in gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Clear the Imps from the Beacon Tower.

variants.specifics: Varnok: Hask, the Guild's bounty clerk, pays to clear the Imps from the slag pits where old Tobb is cut off in his hut.

offer.speaker: Hask
offer.text:
Here for the Imp bounty? If so, you'll want a stout blade. Old Tobb is cut off in his hut at the slag pits east of town, and he can't hold the Imps off much longer!

Well? Shall I put your name down or not?

reminder.speaker: Hask
reminder.text: The bounty still stands. Those Imps grow bolder by the hour.

completion.speaker: Hask
completion.text: Alright. Tobb's home and the pits are quiet. Here is your bounty. Tobb will show you the goat track up Slag Ridge, but no farther. Gorlak's lookouts miss nothing up there.

journal.text: Clear out the Imps and free old Tobb.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Gammel, an old shepherd at the edge of the Thornwood, has lost sheep to the Bears and hides in his loft.

offer.speaker: Gammel
offer.text:
Hello? Is somebody down there? Up here, in the loft!

Oh, it's a person! Thank goodness, I took you for one of them Bears!

The Bears out of the Thornwood come down for my sheep every night now. I'd go after them myself, only my knees, and that big black one would have me.

Here, take the key to the high pasture and see to those Bears. I'll pay what I can when they're gone.

reminder.speaker: Gammel
reminder.text:
I'm staying up here till they're gone.

Go on, then! Get after 'em!

completion.speaker: Gammel
completion.text: Ha! Not a Bear left! Here's your pay, and Mayor Quillon has been asking for you at the Town Hall!

journal.text: Drive the Bears out of Gammel's high pasture.

variants.specifics: Belvik: Grenwold, a herdsman leaving Belvik because of the Ogres, wants the bears of Bramble Gully killed before they eat his flock.

offer.speaker: Grenwold
offer.text:
Ogres on every road and bears in my pens! There's no living left for a herdsman around here. I'm taking my flock south, but I need you to rid me of those bears first.

They've lost all fear of men, and they come for my ewes every night.

Take this potion, and I'll pay the rest when they're dead. Hurry, lad! They'll have eaten every sheep I own before long!

The sheep track behind my pens goes straight up to Bramble Gully.

reminder.speaker: Grenwold
reminder.text: That's all I know. Now get up there and kill those bears!

completion.speaker: Grenwold
completion.text: Thank you! Now my flock and I can make it as far as the south road, but past that, we're on our own. Here's your gold and my old bow. The Ogres of the Grimfell hills have a big appetite for mutton and herdsmen alike.

journal.text: Kill the bears of Bramble Gully.
